clips.title: The story
paras: At Dun Garok, Humbert's Sword lies among the dwarves who took it from his camp. Deathguard Humbert left his post to gather firewood while scouting the stronghold.

Deathguard Humbert left his hidden post near Dun Garok one morning to gather firewood for boiling water. High Executor Darthalia had sent him to watch the dwarven presence there. While he was away, a dwarven patrol found his campsite and plundered his gear, including his personal blade. With so many dwarves to search, Humbert needs Horde agents to enter the fortress and recover it.

Dun Garok's defenders carried Humbert's belongings behind the stronghold's barricades. Riflemen, mountaineers, and priests pass supplies around the garrison. Finding the thief means searching among the defenders in the trenches and redoubts.
